LESSON: BIBLE PATRIARCHS ABRAHAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.6: Bible Patriarchs Abraham

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Bible Patriarchs Abraham. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why was the name Abram changed? 2. How did Abraham show obedience to God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recount the call of Abraham,
2. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life,
3. mention his or her name for self-identity,
4. discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham, e) appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life. The learner is guided to: father of faith, the call of Abraham, names, change of Abraham’s name, appreciate God’s blessings in their lives. Abram changed? show obedience to God?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recount the call of Abraham,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recount the call of Abraham,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life,

3. mention his or her name for self-identity,

4. discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham, e) appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life. The learner is guided to: father of faith, the call of Abraham, names, change of Abraham’s name, appreciate God’s blessings in their lives. Abram changed? show obedience to God?

The learner is guided to: father of faith, the call of Abraham, names, change of Abraham’s name, appreciate God’s blessings in their lives. Abram changed? show obedience to God?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Bible Patriarchs Abraham.
2. Explain Bible Patriarchs Abraham to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: sing the song about Abraham the father of faith,
4. Show that you can: recount the call of Abraham,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bible Patriarchs Abraham. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why was the name Abram changed? 2. How did Abraham show obedience to God?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing the song about Abraham the father of faith,
2. Read Genesis 12:1-5 and retell the call of Abraham,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recount the call of Abraham,
2. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life,
3. mention his or her name for self-identity,
4. discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham, e) appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life. The learner is guided to: father of faith, the call of Abraham, names, change of Abraham’s name, appreciate God’s blessings in their lives. Abram changed? show obedience to God?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
